notes_for_editor: Two Bryan County list entries: GA210 'pembroke' (74 ft) and GA411 'pembroke nw' (106 ft). Their coordinates are about 6 km apart by my calculation from the list coordinates, so a human should decide whether they are one tower or two before publishing. The 'Ron' note on GA411 is unexplained. Do not merge with the Pembroke tower in Robeson County, North Carolina (tnlandforms nct130; the cached easternuslookouts.weebly.com 'Pembroke' page documents a 1928-1930 tower there): that is a different structure. The town link is by name only; no source ties either entry to the town. Two web searches and the cached NHLR and FFLOS pages gave no build, fire, staffing or status source. The NHLR Georgia page is an undated crawl; its 29 listed names were read in full on 2026-10-21 and none matches either Pembroke entry. No corrections; no photos found.
